title: Expand RMS sidebar menu and open Map Monitor
summary: From the RMS home screen, expand the (sometimes hidden) sidebar menu and select the second option, Map Monitor, to view the map and AGV movements.
when_to_use: Use when you need to access the RMS Map Monitor view to view the map and AGV movements.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the RMS navigation (expand sidebar and open Map Monitor) and confirm the Map Monitor view loads.
access_or_tools_needed: Expanded sidebar menu options (Map Monitor as the second option)

visual_references.description: RMS home screen context showing the expandable sidebar menu (item number three) and that the second option after expansion is Map Monitor; includes note that Map Monitor allows viewing the map and AGV movements.

steps.title: Locate the RMS sidebar menu area (may be hidden)
steps.purpose: Find the navigation control needed to reach Map Monitor.
steps.instruction: On the RMS home screen, locate the sidebar menu area. The menu may be hidden.
steps.expected_result: You can see the sidebar menu area/control on the RMS home screen (even if currently collapsed/hidden).
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS home screen is visible and the sidebar menu can be expanded from the home screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the sidebar menu area/control to expand it.

actions.label: Locate sidebar menu area
actions.exact_action: On the RMS home screen, locate the sidebar menu area; note that the menu may be hidden.

steps.title: Expand the sidebar menu by clicking the referenced control (item number three)
steps.purpose: Reveal the navigation options so you can select Map Monitor.
steps.instruction: Expand the sidebar menu by clicking the referenced control (the source calls out “item number three”).
steps.expected_result: The sidebar menu expands and shows multiple options.
steps.healthy_condition: The sidebar menu is expanded (not collapsed/hidden) and options are visible.
steps.failure_condition: The sidebar menu does not expand after clicking the referenced control.

actions.label: Expand sidebar menu
actions.exact_action: You can expand it by clicking (item number three).

steps.title: Select the second option: Map Monitor
steps.instruction: In the expanded sidebar menu, select the second option: Map Monitor.
steps.expected_result: Map Monitor is selected from the sidebar menu.
steps.healthy_condition: The second option in the expanded sidebar menu is Map Monitor and is selectable/clicked.
steps.failure_condition: Map Monitor is not present as the second option after expanding the sidebar menu.

actions.label: Open Map Monitor
actions.exact_action: Once it's expanded, the second option is the map monitor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Map Monitor does not appear as the second option after expanding the sidebar, stop and escalate (no additional navigation troubleshooting is provided in the source).

steps.title: Confirm Map Monitor view opens and shows the map and AGV movements
steps.purpose: Verify you reached the correct RMS view and it is displaying the expected content.
steps.instruction: Confirm the Map Monitor view opens and shows the map and AGV movements.
steps.expected_result: The Map Monitor screen is displayed, showing the map and AGV movements.
steps.healthy_condition: Map Monitor is visible and AGV movements are shown on the map.
steps.failure_condition: Map Monitor does not open, or the map/AGV movement display is not shown.

actions.label: Verify Map Monitor content
actions.exact_action: Confirm the Map Monitor view opens and shows the map and AGV movements.

success_criteria: Map Monitor screen is displayed in RMS.
The Map Monitor screen shows the map and AGV movements.
healthy_conditions: Sidebar menu expands successfully and Map Monitor is available as the second option.
Map Monitor loads and displays the map with AGV movements.
failure_conditions: After expanding the sidebar, Map Monitor is not the second option.
Map Monitor does not open or does not display the map and AGV movements.
escalation_guidance: If Map Monitor does not appear as the second option after expanding the sidebar, stop and escalate (no additional navigation troubleshooting is provided in the source).
